entities.summary: Clarence Ross was a performers & entertainers in Oakland (1923-10-26, Oakland – 2008-04-30) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
